evidence: Phase 0 experiments 1-4 on a live call, 15 Oct 2026; guided call test passed 16 Oct 2026
notes: Voice session = SIM slot index + 1 (slot 2 -> VoiceMMode2 -> Incall_Music_2 proven; slot 1 unverified). Device mutes need a direct ioctl write (stock tinymix rejects them). Host silence: both Cirrus speaker/earpiece amps held at 'Muted' (enum 0) for the daemon's lifetime; the in-call earpiece route runs through the Left amp (PRI_TDM_RX_0), so this silences ringback, busy/unavailable tones and local call tones too.
